source: A test class is only worth as much as the code it holds to account. Imagine a TestCase with four methods: self.assertEqual(letter_grade(95), "A"), self.assertEqual(letter_grade(80), "B"), self.assertEqual(letter_grade(12), "F"), and self.assertRaises(ValueError, letter_grade, 130). Write letter_grade so all four hold: 90 and above is an A, 80 a B, 70 a C, 60 a D, anything lower an F, and a score outside 0 to 100 raises ValueError. Watch the boundaries — 80 is a B, not a C.
